title: The Elders of the South
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in Yevamot 45a, Zevachim 22b and Chullin 132b. Hyman considers the reference usually to be the city of Lod, where several of the Tannaim and Amoraim lived: as in Pesachim 70b, where Yehudah ben Durtai went there; Rabbi Afes, Eruvin 65b; Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi; Rabbi Simlai of the South; and many other sages of the generation.
